    Restriction and extension of cutoff pairs #

    Lemma 7.2 and Lemma 7.3 of the manuscript, in cutoff coordinates. A cutoff pair on n + 1 vertices restricts to a cutoff pair on the first n vertices (CutoffPair.restrict). The pairs restricting to a given p are parametrized by the set Cont of continued rows among the candidate rows (the rows reaching column n - 1, together with the new row n) and an admissible cutoff for the new column (glue, exists_glue). Summing the weights over a fibre gives q^{|ind|} · Δ_q(x^{ρ + 2}) (fiber_sum), so the total weight cpSum satisfies cpSum (n + 1) = Δ_q(x² · cpSum n) (isDelta_cpSum), and cpSum n = B_{n+1} (Theorem 7.5).
